Privacy policy

Last updated: 29 October 2026

AgentOffice runs on your computer. It needs no account, shows no ads, collects no usage statistics (telemetry) and sends nothing about you to us. We have no server.

What stays on your computer

Your settings, notes, to-dos, alarms and reminders, water log, the locations of files on the file shelf, office names and the work board are kept only on this computer, in the app’s own data folder under %LOCALAPPDATA%. The file shelf never copies or uploads files; it only remembers where they are. Uninstalling removes this data (for the Microsoft Store version, Windows removes it).

Local files it reads

  • Claude Code: chat records in %USERPROFILE%\.claude\projects (title, working folder, the first sentence of the last reply, the chat’s state) and the Claude desktop app’s chat list (title, archived state, the link that opens the chat). Read only.
  • Claude Code settings (%USERPROFILE%\.claude\settings.json): only when you choose Connect does AgentOffice add its own entries (a small helper that passes events to the app, and the status line). A backup is made first, your other settings are left alone, and Disconnect removes only these entries.
  • Codex: session records in %USERPROFILE%\.codex\sessions, read only; limits are read by asking the Codex program on your computer. If you connect Codex’s hooks, AgentOffice adds only its own entries to Codex’s hooks.json (backup first); Disconnect removes them.
  • Cursor (optional): if you connect it, AgentOffice adds only its own entries to %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\hooks.json (backup first). Cursor’s chat database is not read.
  • Windows itself: what is playing (title, artist, artwork), battery, sound output, Wi-Fi name, keyboard language and Caps Lock. Shown on screen only.
  • No entry AgentOffice adds ever approves a question or a tool permission for you.

Requests to the internet

  • Weather (optional, off at first): the city name you type is sent to Open-Meteo to find it, and the chosen city’s coordinates to get the forecast (at most every 30 minutes). Your location is never read.
  • Lyrics (optional, off at first): the playing track’s title, artist, album and length are sent to LRCLIB. Lyrics found are kept on your computer.
  • Claude limits: if Claude Code is signed in on this computer, the Limits panel asks Anthropic’s usage service (api.anthropic.com) using Claude Code’s own sign-in. The sign-in is not stored, logged or sent anywhere else.
  • Icon for media playing in a browser: when media plays on a website, that site’s home page and icon are fetched from that site only, to show its icon. Nothing else is sent.
  • WebView2: the classic installer downloads Microsoft’s WebView2 bootstrapper from Microsoft if the Edge WebView2 Runtime is missing. If the runtime is missing later, the app asks before opening Microsoft’s download page.

Microsoft Store, support and this website

  • Downloads, purchases and updates through the Microsoft Store are handled by Microsoft under its privacy statement.
  • Support goes straight to the crypto addresses shown on the site. Transactions on public blockchains are public by nature; we receive nothing else about you.
  • This website uses no analytics, cookies or trackers and loads nothing from other services. Your language choice is kept in your own browser. The site is served by GitHub Pages, which may keep standard server logs. The feedback form sends nothing by itself.

Sharing and children

We do not sell or share your data; it never reaches us. Requests to the services above follow their own privacy policies. AgentOffice is not directed at children and asks no one for personal information.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, this page and its date are updated. For questions, write to eyra@hotmail.com.tr or on Telegram @eyrafx; bugs are best reported on GitHub Issues.
